content:
elena_se: Heads-up: Acme Partner asked for per-question attachments for SIG and CAIQ. They're expecting a single archive plus per-question pointers. Deadline: COB Fri. I started a checklist in the XLS they sent (attached).

 taylor_security: I can own CAIQ controls mapping (controls 2.1-2.12) and the MFA/access proofs. I have screenshots and an MFA policy excerpt. Will redact usernames.

 vivian_csm: I will confirm legal redaction limits with Acme and ask whether a signed attestation is required for SOC/TSC items. Also will ask if they accept presigned links.

 michael_ps: I'll take backup/DR questions and logging/monitoring (Q9-Q11). I have the DR test summary and CloudWatch -> archived logs retention policy.

 ops-bot: File uploaded: acmepartners_SIG_request_2026-03-10.xlsx (uploaded by elena_se) :file_folder:

 elena_se: Can someone upload artifacts to s3://redwood-shared/sig-uploads/acmepartners/1801234567/ please. Use object encryption with cmk-redwood-prod and deny public ACLs.

 taylor_security: Uploaded mfa_policy_excerpt_redacted.pdf and iam_role_audit_90d.csv to that path. Generating presigned links now.

 michael_ps: Uploaded dr_recovery_test_2026-02-15.pdf and logs_retention_policy_v2.pdf

 elena_se: For model/data handling Q16: we need a one-liner about ephemeral prompts + customer-controlled retention for Dedicated. Keep it short.

 taylor_security: Suggested: 'Hosted: default non-persistence of prompts; persisted debugging traces are encrypted with CMKs and access is logged. Dedicated/Private: customer controls KMS and network egress.' OK?

 vivian_csm: Good. Also Acme asked for contact to escalate for legal. Use legal@redwood.com and we can add signatures if they request.

 michael_ps: Generating presigned URLs (expires 72h):
 - mfa_policy_excerpt_redacted.pdf: https://presign.example/mfa_policy_excerpt.pdf?exp=72h
 - iam_role_audit_90d.csv: https://presign.example/iam_role_audit.csv?exp=72h
 - dr_recovery_test_2026-02-15.pdf: https://presign.example/dr_recovery_test.pdf?exp=72h
 - logs_retention_policy_v2.pdf: https://presign.example/logs_retention_policy.pdf?exp=72h

 elena_se: I'll assemble the packet (zip) and the per-question short-answer doc. Connor mentioned a template we used last quarter; copying that format. Who wants to review before I send?

 taylor_security: I will review the security answers. Please highlight any area where we're giving 'operational' vs 'configurable by customer' answers.

 vivian_csm: I'll handle the email to Acme and note anything they push back on. ETA 2h.

 ops-bot: Reminder: SIG packet due 2026-03-13T23:59Z (created by elena_se) :calendar:
